description: Search Roraima listings by town or province, country, dates and number of guests. With check_in and check_out, only listings free on those nights are returned, each with its total price and a link to its page with dates and guests filled in. The amenity filters return only nights listings whose host has stated that amenity.

air_conditioning.description: true: only listings with air conditioning.

country.description: ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 country code, e.g. IT.

entire_place.description: true: only listings where the guest has the entire place, not a room.

language.description: Language of names, descriptions and page links. Default en.

location.description: Town name, or the two-letter code of an Italian province (SS for the province of Sassari). Province names are matched only as town names.

parking.description: true: only listings with parking, free or paid (get_listing says which).

pets_allowed.description: true: only listings that accept pets, also on request (get_listing says which).

name: search_listings
title: Search holiday rentals
